name: Tina Kotek
stance: Says frontier-AI oversight belongs at the federal level but, absent it, ordered Oregon to set third-party safety review standards and assess a kill switch for frontier models the state buys.

statements.text: Issued Executive Order 26-26 directing the state CIO to define frontier AI, set third-party safety review standards for procurement and assess whether to require a kill switch.
While oversight and regulation would be strongest at the federal level, President Trump continues to dismiss the need for even the most basic guardrails.
It's encouraging to hear AI companies are beginning to come forward with proposals to address safety concerns, but we cannot simply wait for the private sector to self-regulate.
Signed SB 1546, requiring AI chatbot operators to detect self-harm signals and not encourage them, with a private right of action.
